items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Alice is the band, Mick Kennedy, got for it.

ctx.x: Oh, come on. Is this the band pick? Yeah, it was the band in Biloxi. Yeah, the Tokyo Roo. No, Johnny Patoos and Biloxi, man, and Alice Stratik. Is that the band saying?
Yeah. Alice is the band, Mick Kennedy, got for it.
Trombone player. He used to part his nose into the pistachio, and we come up to trombone Alice, you know.
